name: componize-alfresco-mcp
description: Search, browse, and manage documents in BARBRI's Componize-hosted Alfresco CMS from Claude.
long_description: Lets Claude Desktop search, browse, upload/download, and manage properties on documents stored in BARBRI's Componize-hosted Alfresco Content Services repository. Each user signs in with their own Componize login, so actions in Alfresco are attributed to them individually. Forked from the open-source python-alfresco-mcp-server project. Componize-specific (DITA CMS) tools are planned for a future version.

alfresco_url.title: Componize/Alfresco URL
alfresco_url.description: Bare host only (e.g. https://barbri.componize.com) — no /alfresco/api/... path. The client appends the full REST path itself on every call; including it here causes every request to 404.

alfresco_password.title: Componize Password
alfresco_password.description: Your personal Componize/Alfresco login password. Stored securely in your OS keychain, never in a file.
